text:
oliver_sales: Cascade Financial wants a compact POC next week. Requirements: low-latency streaming, function/tool-calls that emit strict JSON schema, SAML SSO + customer KMS, and a procurement-friendly month-over-month estimate for reserved vs hosted. Can eng produce runnable Node + Python samples in ~48h?

nina_eng: Yes — we can deliver Node WS + Python SSE samples plus a tiny replay driver to simulate ~1k QPS. Will include a short script to measure p50/p95. Minimal WS send for demo: `ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'parse_tx',stream:true}))`.

peggy_se: For structured output we should use function-calling with an explicit JSON Schema. Demo will show the validator rejecting mismatches and returning a structured 422 error so integrators can handle deterministically. Example expected function return (stringified): `{"tool":"extract_tx","args":{"sender":"string","recipient":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}`. On mismatch return `{"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","path":"/args/amount","received":"string"}}`.

nina_eng: Ops notes: recommend reserved pool for steady tail-latency. Batching window 15-25ms balances throughput and latency. Fallback policy: overflow -> lower-cost model variant with `x-redwood-fallback: true` header. API auth: ephemeral STS tokens (TTL 15m-1h). KMS: support AWS/GCP/azure CMKs and HSM.

jordan_ops: I'll provision a sandbox and attach their AWS CMK once we get the replay script. Need samples by EOD to run perf. Deploy bot will create sandbox cluster.

tess_legal: Send security questionnaire to legal@redwood.ai. Upload link for Cascade: https://onetrust.example.com/cascade-upload. They asked for SOC2, KMS control docs, and data residency confirmation. I'll circulate NDA and standard security packet.

ci_bot: docs: Streaming SDKs -> https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming  |  Tool/Function calls -> https://docs.redwood.ai/tool-calls  |  KMS -> https://docs.redwood.ai/kms-integration

peggy_se: Demo tip: show a small UI validating the returned JSON against schema and highlight field errors, then show auto-retry with a tightened prompt. Also demo structured fallback payload `{"result":null,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_FIELD","field":"amount"}]}` so downstream systems can handle it.

jordan_ops: Timeline: collect Cascade sample prompts today, perf replay tomorrow AM, live demo 2pm PT. I'll open an infra ticket if we hit capacity.

oliver_sales: Great — I'll ask Cascade to share prompt samples and their security contact now. @tess_legal I'll send NDA. :thumbsup:
